video_title: NBA Superstar LeBron James to the 76ers?! Thanasis Antetokounmpo reacts to a WILD NBA Offseason

quotes.speaker: Tony Cartagena
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James to the 76ers is a surprising offseason rumor
quotes.excerpt: LeBron going to the 76ers just seems so far-fetched.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Cartagena
text_blocks.text: The biggest story of the offseason, LeBron going to the 76ers. We got to hit on that in this episode as well because let me tell you, not a lot of things in sports are that surprising. LeBron going to the 76ers just seems so far-fetched.

text_blocks.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: No, but Tony, that's when you deal with amateurs. When you do it with professionals, everything is tied to the chest. Nothing can slip away, and you make your final move.

quotes.speaker: Tony Cartagena
quotes.summary_phrase: The 76ers have a strong roster with young, cheap talent
quotes.excerpt: When you have young, cheap pieces like that who can compete at championship levels, your team is in such a good spot.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Cartagena
text_blocks.text: We know who else is on that Philly roster, but when you have young, cheap pieces like that who can compete at championship levels and at playoff levels right off the bat, your team is in such a good spot. I look at their roster, and he's one of the guys that I'm almost most excited to see LeBron pair up with.

text_blocks.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: Do you want me to give you some predictions? I know for sure.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Prediction that the 76ers will make a trade before December
quotes.excerpt: They're going to make a trade before December. Small, big, they will make a trade.

text_blocks.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: The first prediction is they're going to make a trade before December. Small, big, they will make a trade because it's a lot of pieces that go together and a lot of people who want the ball. Joel Embiid wants the ball.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Cartagena
text_blocks.text: How does he can be effective if he doesn't have the ball?

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brown needs the ball to be effective in Philadelphia
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brown needs the ball in his hands. Now, can he play defense?

text_blocks.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: I'm going to say Brown, Jalen Brown needs the ball in his hands. Now, can he play defense? He can play one of the best defenses in the league. I've seen it with my own eyes, he can play great defense.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Cartagena
text_blocks.text: What are you going to ask Jalen Brown to do? To play like Brook Lopez and defend just block shots?

quotes.speaker: Tony Cartagena
quotes.excerpt: If I was building a team to defend the 76ers, I would want my lead guard to be a crazy quick defender.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Cartagena
text_blocks.text: If I was building a team to defend the 76ers, I would want my lead guard to be a crazy quick defender and also a big body. Damian Lillard checks all those boxes.

text_blocks.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: I defend. For example, I would put multiple positions. I get a lot of guys who switch, switch a lot, and just make them make a play.

quotes.speaker: Tony Cartagena
quotes.summary_phrase: Building a defensive team to stop the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: I would want my lead guard to be a crazy quick defender and also a big body.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Cartagena
text_blocks.text: I would want my lead guard to be a crazy quick defender and also a big body. Damian Lillard checks all those boxes. I would want two of my bigs to be very agile. Brook Lopez, great defender, he's a different type of defender than Giannis is. Bam, exact same, great defender, different type of defender than Mitchell Robinson is or than Joel Embiid is.

text_blocks.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: If you have one complementary piece and someone who is as good a defender as Chris Middleton was, and now you're frustrating them at all levels, that's how I think you start to build around them.

quotes.speaker: Tony Cartagena
quotes.summary_phrase: Denver Nuggets matching the offer sheet for Peyton Watson
quotes.excerpt: They put him on an offer sheet and Denver matched it.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Cartagena
text_blocks.text: I know they put him on an offer sheet and Denver matched it.

text_blocks.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: Yeah, but what did that do for Denver though? Did you understand what's going to happen? I think it screwed them over.

quotes.speaker: Tony Cartagena
quotes.summary_phrase: Cleveland Cavaliers roster analysis after re-signing Donovan Mitchell
quotes.excerpt: They resigned Donovan Mitchell. They don't get LeBron, but their team is still they have Mobley, they have Allen.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Cartagena
text_blocks.text: They resigned Donovan Mitchell. They don't get LeBron, but their team is still they have Mobley, they have Allen, they have James Harden, they have Donovan Mitchell. They just added, I think for less than $3 million, Hazzonia. He's coming back there.

text_blocks.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: Mario, Super Mario.

quotes.speaker: Tony Cartagena
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA veteran contract decision: NBA team vs European contract
quotes.excerpt: You get to age 35, NBA team can offer you one year 12 million, or you can get a European contract.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Cartagena
text_blocks.text: You get to age 35, NBA team can offer you one year 12 million, or you can get a European contract for multiple years, the lifestyle, the fans over there. You've already made a ton of money.

text_blocks.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: Give me the number. Give me the number. Give me the number.

quotes.speaker: Tony Cartagena
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing NBA and European contract earnings for veterans
quotes.excerpt: You can sign for Europe for three years 10 million a year, so you're guaranteed 30 over three years.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Cartagena
text_blocks.text: You can sign for Europe for three years 10 million a year, so you're guaranteed 30 over three years.

text_blocks.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: So let me give you an example now what you just said. If I sign 12 years in the states, that means I'm making six. If I sign overseas 10 million, that means I'm getting 10.
